style: Standalone illustration background for a Japanese haiku reading website, portrait 1024x1536. Minimal atmospheric Japanese watercolor / diluted sumi ink, understated paper texture, few soft shapes, lots of empty space, evocative rather than a literal detailed scene. The imagery is inspired by a poem, not a documentary view of the place. Reserve central and right-central 60% as very calm uniform low-contrast negative space for vertically overlaid text; stronger subject motifs on lower-left or edges; top and bottom calm for small navigation. No writing, no kanji, no lettering, no calligraphy, no seals, no logos, no border, no UI.

Use case: illustration-story. Standalone background art for a Japanese haiku reader, portrait 1024x1536. Sparse Japanese watercolor and diluted ink on warm pale ivory paper, muted warm gray and soft sage. Inspired by the haiku 階段に / かわいいタヌキ / 来ないでね, at Toneri Park in early November: a single cute but natural Japanese raccoon dog (tanuki, rounded ears, dark eye mask, short legs, fluffy brown coat, NOT a raccoon with ringed tail) pauses on a simple outdoor park staircase, seen from a respectful distance. Tender, gently humorous hesitation, no aggression. A few understated autumn leaves beside the steps. Tanuki and softly suggested steps in the lower-left area yet well inside crop edges; generous low-contrast pale negative space in center and right-center for one uninterrupted vertical poem, calm space at top and bottom for navigation. Soft edges, restrained pigment, subtle paper texture, minimal detail. No people, text, lettering, calligraphy, seals, frames, UI or watermarks. Decorative poetic interpretation, not documentary photo.
